script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: “Balaam’s oracle” takes place near Balak’s offering, not in Aram. Aram is where Balaam says he was brought from. Reframe the moment around his journey from Aram.
“Absalom’s vow in Geshur” describes Absalom speaking to David, not an event taking place in Geshur. Reframe it around the vow he says he made while living there, making clear that this is his claim.
Words such as “oracle,” “garrisons,” and “tribute” may be difficult at a 5th-grade reading level. Use simpler wording or briefly explain them.
